location_qualifier: supporting the 25th Division west of the Lunga
notes: Miller, ch. XI: on 10 January 1943 the 155-mm howitzers of the Americal Division's 221st Field Artillery Battalion supported the 25th Division's artillery. Miller, ch. IX, says the battalion did not arrive until January 1943 but gives no landing day; this is a first-observed fire-support claim, not a landing. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
